proofs.text: Send a `tools/call` naming the tool `nope` and then the method `nope/at/all`; verify both answer error code `-32601`

rule_text: An unknown tool name and an unknown method each answer error code `-32601`

tests.body:
def test_an_unknown_tool_and_an_unknown_method_are_errors(self, project):
        responses, _stderr = _rpc(
            project.root,
            {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 1, 'method': 'tools/call',
             'params': {'name': 'nope', 'arguments': {}}},
            {'jsonrpc': '2.0', 'id': 2, 'method': 'nope/at/all'})
        assert responses[0]['error']['code'] == -32601
        assert responses[1]['error']['code'] == -32601
tests.name: test_an_unknown_tool_and_an_unknown_method_are_errors
